set.body:
Represent neural sources with an exact neural domain and typed observation index; represent events with timing and schema; represent observation-level confounds separately; bind clocks, partitions, and row lineage in study().

Partition hierarchy supplies typed axis vocabulary but never chooses generalization or independence.

Acceptance: unequal runs, timing units, missing coverage, censor lineage, and partition nesting are validated per partition; misalignment is a classed refusal naming the partition and remedy; generalizes_over remains an explicit request; sampling_unit and independence remain explicit assumptions.
set.title: Phase 2B: Implement typed observation, event, confound, and study bindings
